name: Customer Screening Validation
validation_logic: FAIL when wallet_status == OPENED and (screening_status != CLEAR or screening_evidence_present == false). If required screening evidence is unavailable and the policy does not establish a mandatory evidence requirement, use UNKNOWN; under the current synthetic policy, missing mandatory evidence is a FAIL.
unknown_conditions: Required screening information is unavailable and the policy does not establish a mandatory evidence requirement.
expected: Customer must have a CLEAR screening result and mandatory screening evidence before wallet activation.

name: Customer Risk Validation
validation_logic: FAIL when risk_level == HIGH and wallet_status == OPENED and risk_exception_approved == false. An approved exception with a reference and reviewer is a PASS for this control.
unknown_conditions: Required risk information is unavailable to determine whether the control can be assessed.
expected: High Risk customers must not be opened without an approved exception.

name: Arabic Name Presence Validation
validation_logic: FAIL when name_ar is empty or contains no Arabic-script character. This MVP checks script presence only; it does not validate legal-name correctness or transliteration accuracy.
unknown_conditions: Arabic name information is unavailable and the control cannot determine whether an Arabic-script name is present.
expected: Customer record must contain an Arabic-script customer name.

name: Dormant Account Handling Validation
validation_logic: FAIL when account_status == DORMANT and wallet_status == OPENED and dormant_handling_status != COMPLETED.
unknown_conditions: Required dormant-account information is unavailable to determine whether the control can be assessed.
expected: Dormant accounts must complete the required dormant-account handling before wallet activation.

name: Source-to-Report Reconciliation
source_definition: approved_source_population.csv; canonical population = distinct partner requests with requested_wallet=YES that also exist in customer master; duplicate partner rows are deduplicated by customer_id before reconciliation. Processing fields are joined from screening and wallet initialization.
validation_logic: FAIL when an approved-source customer is missing from the final report, an unexpected report customer exists, or any key field differs. Multiple mismatches for the same customer produce one RECON_001 finding with all mismatched fields in evidence.
unknown_conditions: Required source or final report data is unavailable, preventing a reliable reconciliation.
expected: The final wallet audit report must accurately reflect the approved source population and all required customer-level processing fields.
